This 2023-06-30 completion statement pre-dates that 2024-07 bid amendment, which is an apparent tension worth the P4785 researcher/coordinator checking directly -- possibly the 2024 bid amendment covers a different/later phase of the same corridor, or the 2023 completion statement is itself only partial. Not independently investigated further here (out of scope for this row).

瑞金-会昌段 is named as built-and-operating as of 2023-06-30. GEM has no 瑞金-会昌 row: P4788 is 信丰-瑞金段 (operating) and THIS row is the onward 会昌-寻乌段, currently `shelved`. So the corridor is reported complete right up to 会昌, the town this row starts from, which weakens `shelved` as a description of the segment's context (though it says nothing directly about 会昌-寻乌 itself). P4786's own shard already carried 瑞金-会昌段 as an owed re-check; this is the document for it. Source: 2023-11-23 SSE bond prospectus (江西省投资集团有限公司 2023年公司债券募集说明书第二期), which lists as 已建成并投产 as of 2023-06-30, verbatim: 「井冈山支线、于都支线、井（冈山支线、井开区支线）安福段、莲花支线、湘东支线、信丰-龙南-定南段、瑞金-会昌段」. Filed by the P5860 agent as a batch-wide lead with no target row; resolved to concrete targets by the orchestrator at merge 2026-09-10 against the live segment names. NOT independently re-verified beyond the quoted list.

信丰-龙南-定南段 is named as built-and-operating as of 2023-06-30. THIS row is 龙南-全南段, `construction`. The two are consistent only if this row's `construction` is scoped to the onward 全南 (Quannan) leg while 信丰→龙南 is already in service — which is the reading the row's own Quannan planning evidence supports. Confirm the scoping rather than treating the completion statement as contradicting the status. Note also that the prospectus's 定南 (Dingnan) leg has no GEM row at all.
